summary: I am okay with not having open access journals, that change will take time, but we need to move our professional organizations away from member only benefit model and make activities open to all and encourage membership through patronage and respect.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I am okay with not having open access journals, that change will take time, but we need to move our professional organizations away from member only benefit model and make activities open to all and encourage membership through patronage and respect.
